description: [WRITE] Create a LINE Yahoo (Yahoo! JAPAN Ads) Conversion API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/line-yahoo-tag), imported automatically. Needs the Yahoo tagId (public), accessToken and channelId. Omit `event` to inherit; Yahoo has NO custom events (unknown names inherit). Every event other than page_view needs its own eventSnippetId from Yahoo Ads. transactionId is the dedup row. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

accessToken.description: Yahoo Ads tag access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

eventParameters.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "LINE Yahoo CAPI Tag".

serverEventData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userIdentifiers.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

webParameters.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_line_yahoo_capi_server_tag
